mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.upstream_field_name AS upstreamFieldName, m.upstream_field_code AS upstreamFieldCode, m.metadata_field_id AS metadataFieldId, mf.field_name AS fieldName, mf.field_code AS fieldCode, m.is_primary_key AS isPrimaryKey, m.transform_type AS transformType, m.transform_value AS transformValue FROM tab_upstream_field_mapping m LEFT JOIN tab_metadata_field mf ON mf.id = m.metadata_field_id WHERE m.source_id = #{sourceId} AND m.data_type = #{dataType} ORDER BY m.id ASC
